This '''city''' was located on [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]]. At one point during its history, the [[City/Legends|city]] was saved by a local named [[Jubieck (warrior)|Jubieck]], who later became famous among [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustans]] for this act.
